description: Land Commissioner General's Department - Mrs. U. D. R. D. Uyanwatta is appointed as a Land Officer for the Central Province - Mrs. H. D. Mangala de Silva is appointed as a Land Officer for Galle District
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the appointment of Land Officers (Mrs. Uyanwatta Gedara Rasika Dilrukshi Uyanwatta and Mrs. Hettiyahandi Dulari Managala De Silva) under the Land Development Ordinance. While it involves personnel appointments, these are specifically for law enforcement/administrative roles within the Land Commissioner General's Department, which is a regulatory and enforcement body. The appointments are made under statutory authority (Land Development Ordinance) and pertain to officers with enforcement responsibilities, fitting the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9) for law enforcement appointments and procedures.
